ModMetaData.name: 奇妙邻里 · 核心框架（开发版）
ModMetaData.description:
奇妙邻里的核心框架，提供迎新、命名、工作、区域管理、建筑目录和百科。需要搭配种族或动物扩展使用。
开发版 0.8.0-dev.2。支持原有人类型邻居和可选的 Animal 帮手模式；幼体外观与年龄床位由家庭模块提供。
需要 RimWorld 1.7 和 Harmony。支持简体中文和英文。
Neighbor Courtyards core framework. Provides arrivals, names, work settings, areas, a building catalog and an encyclopedia. Requires a species or animal expansion.
Development version 0.8.0-dev.2. Supports humanlike neighbors and optional animal helpers. The family module provides child appearance and age-based bed rules.
Requires RimWorld 1.7 and Harmony. English and Simplified Chinese are included.
